name: Goen-sama
source:
[i]"So, you’re there, aren’t you? My bride—come here and let me see your face."[/i]

At the heart of the village lies a volcano, and within it resides great god known as Goen-sama. Goen-sama banished the night and granted fire to all the villagers.

[Translated from [url=https://hyakunie.com/character/goen-sama/]official website[/url]]
